name: cloudbase-cli
description: CloudBase CLI (tcb, 云开发CLI, Tencent CloudBase命令行) resource management skill. Use when deploying cloud functions, CloudRun, storage, NoSQL/MySQL, static hosting, permissions, CORS/domains via tcb; for CI/CD and batch ops; when the user prefers CLI; or as the first-session fallback when CloudBase MCP tools are not loaded yet (after install/config, before IDE restart). Also covers tcb login and site switching (国内站/国际站 via --intl or config isIntl), environment lifecycle (env create/modify/renew/dele
author: TencentCloudBase
